The IRS satelite system became operational with the launching of IRS-IA in March 1988 from Vaikanour in Russia. India has also developedt her own Launching Vehicle PSLV (Polar Satellte Launch Vehicle], These satelites collect data in several spectral bands and transmit them to the ground stations for various uses. The National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) at Hyderabad provides faciifes for acauisition of deta and its processing. These are very useful in the management of natural resources.
